stocks_intro_1: Ma share akhala chikayikidwe chodalirika kwa zaka zambiri ndipo amaimira zigawo zauchuma mu makampani.
stocks_intro_2: Bitcoin ndi ndalama zadigitala zomwe zinapangidwa mu 2009 zomwe zimagwira ntchito modziyimira popanda kampani kapena boma lililonse.
stocks_intro_3: Koma kodi kukhala ndi zigawo mu kampani kumasiyana bwanji ndi kukhala ndi ndalama zadigitala ngati Bitcoin? Tiyeni tione kusiyana pakati pa Bitcoin ndi Ma Share.
stocks_point_7: Chitetezo chosiyanasiyana pa kukwera kwa mitengo
point_1_summary_1: Bitcoin ndi chuma chachindunji chomwe muli nacho ndi kwathunthu. Masheya ndi magawo a kampani — mtengo wake umadalira utsogoleri, ntchito, ndi zisankho zomwe inu simungazilamulire.
point_2_summary_1: Bitcoin ili ndi malire akhwawakhwa a 21 miliyoni ya BTC. Makampani akhoza kupereka masheya atsopano nthawi iliyonse, kuchepetsa eni masheya omwe alipo — ofanana ndi momwe fiat
point_2_summary_3: kumachepetsa ndalama zenizeni. Ndi Bitcoin, gawo lanu silichepa.
point_3_summary_1: Bitcoin ilibe CEO ndipo ilibe malo amodzi olephera. Masheya amadalira kwambiri utsogoleri — chisankho chimodzi cholakwika kapena kuchoka kungapangitse mtengo kugwa.
point_4_summary_1: Mtengo wa Bitcoin umachokera ku misika ya padziko lonse yotseguka. Mtengo wa masheya umadalira muyezo monga ma P/E ratio omwe akhoza kubisa masheya okwera mtengo kwambiri.
point_5_summary_1: Bitcoin imagulitsidwa 24/7 padziko lonse. Misika ya masheya imatsegulidwa pa nthawi za bizinesi pa masiku a sabata.
point_6_summary_3: kwa Bitcoin ndi pulogalamu yosavuta — palibe broker yofunika. Masheya amakhala ndi ma broker, kukuyikani pachiwopsezo cha munthu wina ngati alephera.
point_7_summary_1: Kuchuluka kokhazikika kwa Bitcoin kumayipangitsa kukhala chitetezo chodalirika cha kukwera kwa mitengo. Masheya ena amapitilira kukwera kwa mitengo, ena samatero — palibe chitsimikizo.
